title: Use of Natural Resources
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 7 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The learner explains uses and misuses of natural resources (water, soil, forests, minerals, wildlife), explores effects of misuse (erosion, drought, pollution, disease, loss of wildlife), and discusses biblical teaching on good use (Genesis 1:28; 2:15; Psalm 24:1; Leviticus 25:23-24 rest for the land).

floor.question: What should we do when we cut a tree?

representations: a chart: resource, use, misuse, effect
a picture of a bare hillside
steps: Give a use and a misuse.
Give the effect of the misuse.
contexts: sand harvesting in a river bed
a borehole shared by a village

board.do: Draw a chart with four columns.

board.say: Name one misuse of water and its effect.

board.do: Wait for the learner to answer.

listen_for: Good use: the river carries it away
misconceptions.ask: A factory pours waste into a river. What is this?
misconceptions.repair: Follow the waste: river, fish, people downstream who drink it.

misconceptions.ask: Which is an effect of cutting trees without replanting?
misconceptions.repair: Show a picture of a bare hillside after rain: gullies, mud in the river.

listen_for: Sweeping it bare so it looks tidy
misconceptions.ask: Which is good use of soil?
misconceptions.repair: Show soil cover (mulch, crops) and explain it holds the soil in rain.

misconceptions.ask: Can natural resources such as water and forests run out?
misconceptions.repair: Show a dried river or a cleared forest in Kenya; read Genesis 2:15 as a call to care.

checks.question: Name an effect of cutting trees without replanting.
Which is good use of soil?
checks.answer: Keeping it covered with crops or mulch
